run_curator_status: run the hermes curator status command to show curator state and agent-created skill statistics
run_curator_review: run the hermes curator review pass to auto-transition stale and archived skills
pause_curator: pause the hermes curator so it stops running scheduled review passes
pin_skill: pin an agent-created skill so the curator never auto-transitions it to stale or archived
restore_archived_skill: restore an archived agent-created skill back to active state using the hermes curator
